items.quote: 24:13 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 24:14 Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp;
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to take the man who had cursed outside the camp.
items.action: commanded removal of the one who cursed to outside the camp

items.quote: and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
items.claim: The text lays out a two-step procedure: everyone who heard the cursing lays their hands on the man's head, and then the whole congregation stones him.
items.actor: all that heard him; all the congregation
items.action: lay hands upon his head, then stone him
items.mechanism: communal laying on of hands followed by communal stoning
